title: Lateral Reading
skills: use lateral reading to investigate unfamiliar sources
verify claims by consulting independent sources
evaluate source reputation and credibility beyond a single webpage
apply fact-checking strategies during online research
alignment_note: Introduces lateral reading as a source-evaluation strategy that involves leaving a webpage to investigate its author, organization, claims, and reputation through independent sources. Supports information literacy, digital research, credibility assessment, fact-checking, and responsible evidence selection across high school English courses.
